title: Nexus StrategyComposeRequest
description: Body of POST /v1/daemon/strategies/{strategy_id}/compose. Exactly one composition operation, guarded by the candidate revision the client last read. The path `strategy_id` is authoritative: raw document bytes and multi-operation blobs are not accepted.

oneOf.title: NestCompose
oneOf.description: Pin one library package as a new collapsed slot under `parent_node`.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the client last read. The write commits `base_revision + 1`, or is refused as `strategy_candidate_conflict` with no write.

nest_id.description: Stable nest id; the region address for `unnest`, `replace_subtree` and `bind_slot`.

parent_node.description: Id of the collapsed `pattern_slot` node this operation inserts.

attach_to.description: Existing node the new slot is wired after: the daemon writes one `linear` edge `attach_to -> parent_node` on the committed document, so the static walk reaches the slot. Omitted or null writes no edge, and a target that names no node is refused as a dangling edge.

id.description: Pattern registry id, which is also the package directory name.

version.description: Exact version label from the package manifest. The daemon resolves the content hash; the caller never supplies one.

expansion.description: When the region expands into concrete nodes and edges.

oneOf.title: UnnestCompose
oneOf.description: Flatten the region at `nest_id` out of the candidate.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the client last read. The write commits `base_revision + 1`, or is refused as `strategy_candidate_conflict` with no write.

nest_id.description: Nest id of the region to flatten.

oneOf.title: ReplaceSubtreeCompose
oneOf.description: Re-pin the region at `nest_id` to another exact package, in place.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the client last read. The write commits `base_revision + 1`, or is refused as `strategy_candidate_conflict` with no write.

nest_id.description: Nest id of the region to re-pin; the region keeps its slot node, bindings and graph position.

id.description: Pattern registry id, which is also the package directory name.

version.description: Exact version label from the package manifest. The daemon resolves the content hash; the caller never supplies one.

expansion.description: When the re-pinned region expands into concrete nodes and edges.

oneOf.title: BindSlotCompose
oneOf.description: Bind one slot of the pattern pinned at `nest_id`.

base_revision.description: Candidate revision the client last read. The write commits `base_revision + 1`, or is refused as `strategy_candidate_conflict` with no write.

nest_id.description: Nest id whose pinned pattern declares the slot.

slot.description: Slot name from the pinned package manifest.

value.description: Bound value. The manifest's slot declaration decides its kind (string, asset id or capability id); the daemon refuses a mismatch with a named 422.
